programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 擁有雙重面貌卻守節十五年的蒙面寡婦，在白天是個足不出戶、行為謹慎的女人。到了晚上，她就會翻牆出去，戴著面紗去照顧那些有需要的人。在某天晚上卻遇到了追查年幼時慘死的父親死因的男人。這使她開始對未來有所憧憬。但當他們一起捲入一場意想不到的事件時，生活發生了巨大的變化。

programme.title: E8
programme.desc: 于氏王后的丈夫高句麗王突然去世給宮廷帶來一場腥風血雨。根據高句麗的群婚制度，王后必須與先王的一位弟弟結婚，于氏為了阻止對王位充滿欲望的宰相及王子們，設法在24 小時內將先王的胞弟推上王位而展開一場熱血追逐。

programme.title: E4
programme.desc: 刑警何遠航（潘粵明 飾）與其徒弟冉方旭（王鶴棣 飾）調查一起涉及徐家父女的神秘失蹤案。1997年，二人在元龍里小區電梯口失蹤，冉方旭最初認定案件為惡意逃債，但2006年，徐父的遺體被意外發現，推翻了這一結論。 近十年後，何遠航的女兒、已成為警察的何曉荷（任敏 飾）發現案件與過往線索的關聯。她與父親聯手，欲在小區拆遷前夕最終揭露真相。

programme.title: E15
programme.desc: 「申二朗」律師在舊巫堂開設法律事務所後，開始看得見鬼魂。雖然外表沉穩可靠，但實際上膽小又有些冒失；然而在面對帶著冤屈的鬼魂委託人時，卻展現出誰也無法動搖的堅定氣度。他與菁英律師「韓娜賢」以「法律」為武器替非常特別的委託人洗刷冤屈。

programme.title: The Movie Star Says -Sandra Ng
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer?

programme.title: Thou Shall Not Commit
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Feng was an orphan. When he went on a date with a writer Zhi, Zhi died unexpectedly. After Feng was out of prison, his father's old friend Wei took him home to stay temporarily. One day, Feng received mysterious phone message from a woman Qi, and then he began to be deeply in love with her. Under the guidance of Wei, a love expert, Feng finally won Qi's heart. Wei suddenly arrived while Feng and Qi were having their breakfast in bed...

programme.title: The National Dog Show ('20)
programme.desc: From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. Hosted by John O'Hurley, the event features 2,000 of the nation's leading canines, including the world’s largest, smallest and most exotic. Over 170 breeds strut their stuff with the hope of becoming this year's top dog. “The Dean” David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. But which dog will have their day, and which will leave with their tail between their legs? After all, there can only be one “Best in Show”.

programme.title: The Case - Continuous Homicide
programme.desc: One night in Hong Kong, a clip of self-immolation began to go viral on the Internet. Before she died, the female deceased muttered words like she had hit an evil spirit. Then she picked up a lighter and lit it. Her whole body was on fire, and she screamed in pain. All the environmental evidence points to the teacher assisting others to commit suicide. The only thing is that he refused to admit murder, saying that he lost his memory...

programme.title: Broker
programme.desc: 'Sanghyeon' is always struggling from debt, and 'Dongsu' works at a baby box facility. On a rainy night, they steal the baby 'Woosung,' who was left in the baby box, to sell him at a good price. Meanwhile, detectives were watching, and they quietly track them down to capture the crucial evidence.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E274 -Night King
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Uniform
programme.desc: Set in 1997's Banqiao, Taiwan, the story explores the struggles and brilliance of a girl named Xiao Ai as she navigates her journey of growth. Originally accepted into her dream high school, Xiao Ai is compelled by her mother to transfer to the night school at Taipei First Girls' High School. Sharing desks with day students during the day, she forms a deep friendship with her 'desk mate,' Min Min. However, feeling inferior because of her identity as a night school student, she and Min Min both develop feelings for the gifted student, Luke. To conceal the truth, she dons the day school uniform and pretends to be the 'perfect girl' who matches Luke. The green uniform gives her confidence, but it also causes her lies to spiral out of control. On the day of the joint entrance exam, the truth is revealed, and Xiao Ai faces a heart-wrenching trial of growth amidst the storms of friendship, love, and family...

programme.title: E30
programme.desc: 人生進入瓶頸期的職場精英梁友安和習慣了坐冷板凳的運動員宋三川，因緣際會加入了一個草臺網球俱樂部。他們一個是半路出家的俱樂部經理人，一個是羽毛球轉網球的運動員，兩人和隊友們克服困難共同奮戰，努力打造一個了不起的職業俱樂部。在此過程中，梁友安和宋三川逐漸萌生愛意，也面臨著來自觀念和閱歷的衝突。俱樂部不斷髮展，他們在一次次應對挑戰中超越自我、加強信任，最終收穫職業成長和美好愛情。
